name: Spaceship fff1b887 on 4.8.8
description: A period-16 spaceship on the truncated square tiling 4.8.8 (touching neighbours), 14 to 28 cells, moving eight lattice steps every 16 generations (c/2). It runs the same way in the 32 rules from B2/S34 to B278/S34678; the scene uses the rule it was found in. Found by JETCARP's soup search (seen 271 times). Flagged to check before claiming: runs in B2/S34, the rule of the 4.8.8 hunts (Hexagonal Life without its H). We found no earlier report, but others may well have seen it, so it is not claimed.
